text:
Maya: Quick product sync 1: pick sprint scope for Dedicated capacity. Options: (1) customer-configurable headroom per pool + billing tag, (2) minimal Console visibility per-tenant, (3) smarter autoscale fallback to cheaper quantized variants. Which do we push?
Ethan: Prioritize (1) + (2) — fastest impact for pilots. (3) is higher-risk (model drift).
Priya: Agreed. (1) is mostly config + admission. Need schema change and billing_tag so invoicing team can show reserved bump usage.
Jon: Ops: add alerting for sustained headroom consumption >80% for >10m, and a canary metric for headroom-admit-failure-rate. Chaos test required for node drains.
Li: SEs: Console graph reduces support overhead. MVP: read-only sparkline on pool page + CSV export.
Maya: Proposed M1: headroom knob (api flag, billing_tag, default 0%). M2: small Console widget. M3: research track for fallback routing.
Ethan: Effort: M1 ~3 dev-weeks (runtime+backend+qa). M2 ~1.5 dev-weeks. M3 research 4-6w.
Priya: Launch checklist M1: docs + example SDK/curl, billing report, staging->canary->prod deploy with no p95 regressions, metrics emitted (pool.soft_headroom_used, pool.effective_capacity).
Jon: I'll own alerts and chaos tests. Li: I'll mock wireframe for Console MVP and backend contract.
deploy-bot: CI triggered for feature/headroom-config. build queued.
Maya: Decision: ship M1 + thin M2 this sprint, defer M3. Action items: Maya PRD EOD, Ethan schema PR tomorrow, Jon tests, Li mockups Friday, Priya confirm pilot billing today.
Ethan: Example config snippet for PRD will include billing_tag and percent.
Maya: +1 from everyone in thread.
